paper.title: Gradient Flow Dynamics and Implicit Bias of Diagonal Linear Networks under Infinitesimal Initialization

claims.contract_text: The gradient flow algorithm converges to the solution of a modified ℓ1 norm minimization problem.
claims.boundary: Finite exact-rational Algorithm 1 fixture only; continuous-time gradient flow, infinitesimal limit, and theorem assumptions are unverified.

claims.contract_text: The implicit bias of diagonal linear networks under infinitesimal initialization corresponds to modified ℓ1 norm.
claims.boundary: The source theorem and corollary are documented, but no independent proof audit or parameterized continuous-time gradient-flow run is present.
